checks.label: Missing account master
checks.assessment: Position on an account_id missing from accounts
checks.definition: The holding's account_id is absent from accounts. One flag per account/security/snapshot key.

checks.label: Missing security master
checks.assessment: Position on a security_id missing from securities
checks.definition: The holding's security_id is absent from securities. This establishes a missing reference, not its cause.

checks.label: Exact duplicate transactions
checks.assessment: Repeated transaction_id, exact full-row copy
checks.definition: A repeated transaction ID has one distinct raw full-row value. Count one ID case, not its two or more physical copies.

checks.label: Date-normalized duplicates
checks.assessment: Repeated transaction_id, copies differ only by date format
checks.definition: A repeated ID has multiple raw values but one full-row value after explicit date normalization. Both supported date formats are valid; the flag concerns the repeated ID.

checks.label: Conflicting transaction copies
checks.assessment: Repeated transaction_id, copies conflict on a fact
checks.definition: A repeated ID still has multiple distinct full-row values after date normalization. No winning copy is selected.

checks.label: Repeated pipeline IDs
checks.assessment: Repeated transaction_id in the pipeline
checks.definition: More than one pipeline row references the same transaction_id. Count one ID case and retain every source row number.

checks.label: Missing quantity
checks.assessment: Blank trade quantity
checks.definition: The raw transaction quantity is blank. Each physical source row is a separate entity, even when transaction IDs repeat.

checks.label: Negative trade quantity
checks.assessment: Negative trade quantity
checks.definition: Parsed raw quantity is below zero, violating the exercise's nonnegative trade-magnitude convention. Negative holdings are allowed.

checks.label: Missing settlement date
checks.assessment: Blank settlement_date
checks.definition: The raw settlement_date is blank. Nonblank unparseable dates are reported as unevaluable, not silently treated as blanks.

checks.label: Settlement before trade
checks.assessment: settlement_date before trade_date
checks.definition: Both dates parse under ISO or DD/MM/YYYY and scheduled settlement_date precedes trade_date. This is not actual settlement evidence.

checks.label: Broken correction link
checks.assessment: CANCELLED row linked to an ID that does not exist
checks.definition: A CANCELLED row has a populated related_transaction_id absent from the transaction extract. It does not prove the ID never existed elsewhere.

checks.label: Multiple reversals per original
checks.assessment: Two REVERSED rows for each reversed original
checks.definition: More than one REVERSED row references the same original ID. Count one original-ID case, not each reversal row; event semantics remain unresolved.

checks.label: Rebook amount inconsistency
checks.assessment: Rebook changes quantity but keeps the original gross_amount
checks.definition: A BOOKED replacement links to an unambiguous CANCELLED target, changes quantity, and its gross amount fits the target's quantity times price within the configured tolerance.

checks.label: Unmastered spin-off target
checks.assessment: Corporate action target security missing from securities
checks.definition: A SPINOFF event has a populated target_security_id absent from securities. The event list does not establish account-level application.

checks.label: Missing merger target
checks.assessment: MERGER without a target_security_id
checks.definition: A MERGER event has a blank target_security_id, preventing a supported unit-conversion scenario.

checks.label: Questionable event terms
checks.assessment: ratio or cash_rate filled for an event type that does not use it
checks.definition: At least one field marked 'not expected' in the notebook's GUIDE_FIELD_USE is populated. One flag per event regardless of how many fields trigger; this interpretation remains unresolved.

checks.label: Questionable event chronology
checks.assessment: ex_date after effective_date
checks.definition: Both event dates parse and ex_date is after effective_date. Type-specific date meanings are unresolved; this is not automatically an impossible event.

checks.label: Missing preferred-vendor quote
checks.assessment: Preferred vendor has no price on a date
checks.definition: Within an observed preferred security/vendor pair, an observed dataset date has no quote. Preferred means the lowest numeric vendor_priority in the extract. This expected-quote case population is separate from price rows.

checks.label: No vendor pricing coverage
checks.assessment: Held security with no price at all
checks.definition: A held security has no row anywhere in the supplied price table. This is absence of vendor coverage, not absence of a transaction execution price.

checks.label: Price currency without FX coverage
checks.assessment: Price currency with no FX rate
checks.definition: A price row's populated currency is absent from all supplied FX currencies. This tests currency coverage, not date-specific FX eligibility.

checks.label: USD-to-USD rate differs from 1
checks.assessment: USD rate to USD is not 1
checks.definition: The FX row states currency USD and its parsed rate_to_usd is not 1. The notebook's unresolved assessment is preserved, despite the stated USD-per-currency convention.

checks.label: Book / custodian disagreement
checks.definition: Both sources contain the same normalized account/security/snapshot key and finite decimal quantities differ exactly, following notebook 02. A disagreement does not establish which source is correct.

checks.label: Book-only holding
checks.assessment: Position in our book with no custodian record
checks.definition: A valid book holding key is absent from comparison_positions. Absence is never converted into zero quantity.

checks.label: BOOKED trade-rebuild disagreement
checks.assessment: Rebuilt quantity differs from the book (BOOKED-only benchmark)
checks.definition: The raw BOOKED-only trade-date quantity, starting from zero and retaining duplicate rows and raw signs, differs from the book beyond the configured tolerance. Invalid quantities, types, or dates make the key unevaluable; no corporate actions are applied.

checks.label: No contributing BOOKED trades
checks.assessment: Position with no contributing trade
checks.definition: A valid reported holding has no BOOKED trade row for its account/security pair through the snapshot. This is benchmark-specific and does not prove the holding is erroneous.
